description: Review interface strings. Give `items`, one per line, each prefixed with its type: button:, link:, label:, tooltip:, empty:, confirmation:, placeholder:, heading:. Type-specific checks: buttons and links (starts with an action verb, generic labels like OK or Submit, 1 to 3 words, 'click' wording, link text out of context), labels (short, noun-like), tooltips (length, not repeating the control), empty states (says why and offers a next step), confirmations (names what happened or will happen, 'Are you sure?', yes/no buttons). All types: vague error wording, filler, 'please', interjections, technical codes, all capitals. Findings are rated high, medium or low. Pattern checks on single strings in English.

items.description: Strings, one per line, with a type prefix such as 'button: Save changes'
